task: Refactor Action Done Matrix (ADM) module with live real-time Socket.IO editing, unified Secretary Minutes tab toggle, milestone paper isolation (ADM v1, v2, v3), inline faculty add-row (print-hidden), button cleanup, and removal of Image 1 from Capstone 3 Section 1.
user_requests_addressed: Refactor ADM module while preserving all institutional formats (BukSU Form RU-F-033 / OVPAA-F-INS-032).
Adjust default editing mode to live real-time: when a faculty/instructor edits a row, updates broadcast immediately via Socket.IO room.
Include Secretary Minutes in this section with a tab toggle: Action Done Matrix (ADM) and Secretary Minutes (OVPAA-F-INS-032).
Remove unnecessary buttons: 'Load Institutional Template' and 'Live Defense Session & Minutes' with blue real-time defense sync banner.
Restrict minutes PDF / OCR upload strictly to the appointed Secretary (canUploadMinutes = Boolean(isUserSecretary)).
Add an inline row addition interface for faculty/instructor in the ADM table that is strictly hidden on export/print (print:hidden).
Ensure downloading/printing captures the entire ADM paper only without cutting off contents or pagination bugs.
Isolate each capstone's ADM (ADM v1, ADM v2, ADM v3) as independent papers; signatures and remarks do not bleed across milestones (admSignaturesByMilestone).
Remove Image 1 ('6 Compiled Chapter 1–5 or Final Paper') from Capstone 3 Section 1.
learned_lessons: Milestone isolation in MongoDB schemas must store multi-signatory digital signatures in admSignaturesByMilestone keyed by milestone (CAPSTONE_1, CAPSTONE_2, CAPSTONE_3) to prevent signatures from auto-approving other milestone matrices.
Immediate cell blur flush (handleCellBlur) combined with debounced typing ensures real-time Socket.IO broadcasts (adm:row_updated) occur both as users type and immediately when focus leaves a cell.
Full-page printing requires dedicated @media print stylesheets ensuring parent overflow: auto and fixed screen heights are reset to height: auto !important and overflow: visible !important.
Collapsible sections in capstone workflows should use unambiguous semantic data-testid attributes (such as toggle-adm-section) to ensure resilient UI testing.
